name: Chinyong Information Technology Cooperation Company

attribution.legal_posture: Current OFAC exact-ID data adds an administrative IT/computer-services classification. The subject is a DPRK IT company managing worker delegations in Russia and Laos and a DPRK IT-worker dispatch organization subordinate to the Ministry of National Defence. The record carries an administrative sanctions designation; current operations or control fall outside this classification, and no criminal charge or conviction is recorded.

caveats: Administrative sanctions state an administrative status; criminal charges and convictions require separate proceedings.
Administrative sanctions listing; the record carries no criminal conviction.
Birth, passport, identity, address, company-identifier, financial, contact, compliance, and sanctions-boilerplate fields are excluded.
Canonicalize to the Treasury Chinyong entity because Treasury explicitly identifies Jinyong IT Cooperation Company as an alias; spelling similarity alone supplies no canonicalization basis.
The source supplies its recorded transliterations; an alias transfers to a same-name person or entity only when the source explicitly links it.

Exact-ID merge only: each retained value is explicitly attached by the cited official dataset to the same sanctions-list entry; values stay attached to that entry pending a source bridge to any same-name subject.
JINYONG IT COOPERATION COMPANY — official sanctions-list organization-name alias.
SDN.CSV and ALT.CSV are component tables of one OFAC Sanctions List Service dataset/source family; count them as one source family.
The current SDN export is administrative-list evidence; current operations, ownership, control, and location require independent sources.
